amount_rule: TWO RULES, both over the served nodes the page holds (no new request), both only for the whole selection (no Sleeve/Account choice in the table; an account picked means the snapshot in hand is that account's one-account answer, so the same rules run over that account), both only when snapshot.custodyTotalAmount (the Total Assets card's figure) is served and above zero. LINE ONE (sleevesWithoutSecurity, unlistedViewFrom) = the SUM of node.amount over the outermost SLEEVE nodes with no security node beneath them, read from those nodes and never derived as a difference; shown when above 0.01. A SLEEVE is a node of kind 'sleeve' or 'category' (the adapter's kinds for wire SLEEVE and CATEGORY) whose parent is a node of kind 'account', 'sleeve' or 'category'. 'No security node beneath' = no node of kind 'security' anywhere in its subtree, of any amount or basis (the adapter folds wire SECURITY, CASH and UNRESOLVED into kind 'security'); a sleeve nested in a sleeve that itself has none counts once, at the outer; a sleeve with a null amount adds nothing. LINE TWO = total - (sum of node.amount over the listed rows, securityRowsFrom: every kind 'security' node with amount not zero, TARGET basis included, before the selects and the fold) - (line one's amount when line one is shown), rounded to the cent; shown when above 0.01, worded 'not itemised in this table', no cause; not shown when a listed row has no amount (unknown, not guessed). A negative result (rows plus sleeves above the card) prints nothing and is carried as UnlistedView.overrun (row DSGN_IRPTV1-D2-W60-S4).
cash_child_treatment: The page folds a producer CASH node (wire CASH, cashNode true) into kind 'security' and lists it as a row when its amount is not zero. A sleeve whose only child is a CASH node therefore HAS a security node beneath it and is NOT counted in line one, so its amount is never in both a row and line one. A CASH child of amount zero is not a row but is still a security node: its sleeve is not counted in line one either, and any amount it leaves falls in line two (case 'zero CASH child' in the test).
node_says_reason: Only partly. A served node marks a withheld drill (the 'DRILL WITHHELD' capability fact, classification.capabilityFacts on the sleeve); nothing marks a sleeve as cash only. Line one therefore names the producer's two reasons as the producer's and does not say which applies to which sleeve or amount, and does not apportion. It states no cause of its own and line two states none at all.
